Query the Django SQLite database and dump ALL records. Use Python:

python -c "
import sqlite3, os
db = r'C:\Users\kramo\PycharmProjects\djangoProject1\db.sqlite3'
print('DB exists:', os.path.exists(db), os.path.getsize(db))
conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

tables = [
    ('params_envtempparameters', ['id','name','code','description','sorting_order','is_active','min_temp','max_temp']),
    ('params_climaticzoneclassifier', ['id','name','code','description','sorting_order','is_active']),
    ('params_climaticequipmentplacementclassifier', ['id','name','code','description','sorting_order','is_active']),
]

for tbl, cols in tables:
    print(f'\n===== {tbl} =====')
    rows = conn.execute(f'SELECT {",".join(cols)} FROM {tbl} ORDER BY id').fetchall()
    print(' | '.join(cols))
    for r in rows:
        print(' | '.join(str(r[c]) for c in cols))
    print(f'Total: {len(rows)}')

# ClimaticConditions with JOIN
print('\n===== params_climaticconditions (with JOINs) =====')
sql = '''SELECT cc.id, cc.name, cc.code, cc.description, cc.sorting_order, cc.is_active,
       z.name as zone_name, z.code as zone_code,
       p.name as placement_name, p.code as placement_code,
       cc.min_temp_work, cc.max_temp_work, cc.min_temp_extremal, cc.max_temp_extremal
FROM params_climaticconditions cc
LEFT JOIN params_climaticzoneclassifier z ON cc.climaticZone_id = z.id
LEFT JOIN params_climaticequipmentplacementclassifier p ON cc.climaticPlacement_id = p.id
ORDER BY cc.id'''
rows = conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
cols = ['id','name','code','desc','sort','active','zone_name','zone_code','place_name','place_code','min_work','max_work','min_ext','max_ext']
print(' | '.join(cols))
for r in rows:
    print(' | '.join(str(r[c]) if r[c] is not None else 'NULL' for c in cols))
print(f'Total: {len(rows)}')
conn.close()
"
